provider_query:
WITH targets AS (SELECT oid,relname,relowner,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity,relkind FROM pg_class WHERE oid IN ('auth.scim_users'::regclass,'auth.scim_tokens'::regclass)),
 t AS (SELECT t.oid,t.relname, t.relowner::regrole::text AS owner,t.relrowsecurity,t.relforcerowsecurity,t.relkind,s.n_live_tup,s.seq_scan,s.idx_scan,pg_total_relation_size(t.oid) AS bytes FROM targets t LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid=t.oid),
 a AS (SELECT x.relname AS relation,a.attnum,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS datatype,a.attnotnull,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expr FROM targets x JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=x.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=x.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum),
 k AS (SELECT x.relname AS relation,c.conname AS name,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true) AS definition,md5(pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true)) AS md5 FROM targets x JOIN pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid=x.oid),
 i AS (SELECT x.relname AS relation,z.indexrelid::regclass::text AS name,pg_get_indexdef(z.indexrelid) AS definition,md5(pg_get_indexdef(z.indexrelid)) AS md5 FROM targets x JOIN pg_index z ON z.indrelid=x.oid),
 tr AS (SELECT x.relname AS relation,g.tgname AS name,pg_get_triggerdef(g.oid,true) AS definition,md5(pg_get_triggerdef(g.oid,true)) AS md5 FROM targets x JOIN pg_trigger g ON g.tgrelid=x.oid),
 po AS (SELECT x.relname AS relation,p.polname AS name,coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),'') AS qualifier,coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid),'') AS with_check FROM targets x JOIN pg_policy p ON p.polrelid=x.oid),
 grants AS (SELECT x.relname AS relation,r.rolname AS role,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,'auth','USAGE') AS schema_usage,has_table_privilege(r.oid,x.oid,'SELECT') AS can_select,has_table_privilege(r.oid,x.oid,'INSERT') AS can_insert,has_table_privilege(r.oid,x.oid,'UPDATE') AS can_update,has_table_privilege(r.oid,x.oid,'DELETE') AS can_delete FROM targets x CROSS JOIN pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','authenticator','service_role','supabase_auth_admin','postgres'))
SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_utc',now(),'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY relname) FROM t),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY relation,attnum) FROM a),'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY relation,name) FROM k),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) ORDER BY relation,name) FROM i),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(tr) ORDER BY relation,name) FROM tr),'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(po)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM po),'grants',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(grants) ORDER BY relation,role) FROM grants)) AS evidence;
